segments.text:
V. 14.
But his citizens—Such were thoſe of Jeruſalem, hated him, ard ſent an embaſſy after him—The Word ſeems to imply, their ſending Embaſſadors to a ſuperior Court, to enter their Proteſt againſt lus, being admitted to the regal Power, 〈◊〉 ſuch a ſolemn Manner did the Jeus proteſt, as it were, before GOD, that Chriſt ſhould not reign over them. This man—So they call him in Contempt.
